levels.surface: إسحاق بن عبد الله بن أبي طلحة

notes: Two sayings, each with its own isnad (rule 4a): Anas's story, and the words «فرأيت لهما تسعة أولاد» that Sufyan introduces with «قال سفيان فقال رجل من الأنصار»; the second keeps the head Bishr, Sufyan
needs_ruling (rule 11): the second saying is a first-person narrative whose speaker, a man of the Ansar, is unnamed
The Prophet's words «لعل الله أن يبارك لكما» are relayed by Anas inside his story; Anas is the last link of the first saying
